integrity: All general claims rely on a complete analytic compactness-and-localization argument; small finite experiments are supplementary. No independent audit or external certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only a>=2, b>=102400(a+1)^6, the unweighted centered maximal operator and ell_2. The sufficient threshold is not optimal. Numerical checks do not prove universal statements. The two papers on stars already establish the a=1 case, which is excluded. No claim of comprehensive historical priority.
title: Eventual exact Hilbert norms of maximal averages on unbalanced bicliques
